scope: Focused 200k-event Q5 complete-job comparison; does not qualify the full two-million-event matrix.
method: One warmup, three rotating measured trials per engine, release libraries, process-scoped caffeinate -is, unchanged SQL/corpus and resources. Each Maven invocation succeeded after full-value, encoder and zero-native-resource cleanup checks.

profile_diagnostic.note: Before optimization. Inclusive shares can overlap. Instrumented elapsed time does not qualify a speedup.

deadline_cache_profile.note: Inclusive CPU shares overlap; instrumented elapsed time is not a timing gate.
